9245.overview:
Requiring discipline and sweat, stamina and speed, with muscles opposing muscles, compete in the most celebrated game of the Olympics: the ten events of the decathlon. Earn points for each event. Highest final score wins! 

Up to four players compete in the ten different events of a real-life decathlon, either in sequence or individually. The game became somewhat notorious for the amount of wear or damage inflicted upon console controllers, where rapid back-and-forth movement of the joystick propels the athlete down the track.

15077.overview:
This fantastic 3-dimensional space battle game puts you in control of a futuristic spaceship! Your ship zooms over an alien asteroid, and dives down to attack the enemy's installations. Your ship must avoid hazardous walls, enemy fire, and other unforeseen dangers! Can you survive and score?

Unlike the arcade versions (and other home ports) the 2600 version is a top-down vertically scrolling game, rather than the diagonal isometric perspective used in the original arcade version.

31753.overview:
Incomprehensible game about collecting zoo animals.

The game is based on the code of Panda Chase from Home Vision (you can still see the little panda heads when you run out of time).

129014.overview:
You are a flying saucer trying to destroy cities below. You can move any direction and to fire, just hold the button and push that way. The cities will fire missiles at you to stop you. In later levels, the missiles turn into balloon bombs that you mustn't run into and later levels, the balloon bombs turn into horizontally travelling missiles if you are level with the balloon.

There are four game variations. Games one and two are one or two player, respectively, at a beginner level. Games three and four are one or two player, respectively, at advanced level.

You advance to the next level when all the cities of that level are destroyed. The game ends if you reach 999,999 points or lose all of your ships.

134762.overview:
One day an airship came to visit Zippy's happy, little, peaceful land. Curious, Zippy took a peek inside and was overwhelmed with all sorts of gadgets and things that he had never seen before. After a long while of exploring, Zippy found a nice place inside to take a nap. After his nap, he left the ship but found that he was in a whole other land! The ship must have taken off to this new place while he was sleeping. But before he could think of what to do to get back to his home, he noticed someone exiting the ship, riding a smaller air vehicle. 

This moustached man looked strange to him, but his appearance was the least of Zippy's worries, as he noticed that on the vehicle were the five power gems from his home! He must have stolen them! Those gems can be dangerous in the wrong hands! Now it's up too Zippy to get them back and return them to their rightful place.

162197.overview: A binary of the BATARI Basic sample game Zombie Chase, it was developed by Fred Quimby. This game is similar to death race.

163541.overview: In this adaptation of the classic puzzler, gameplay is pretty much like any other clone of Tetris. All the familiar pieces we've come to know and love are all there, and the object is still to strategically place them such that complete rows are created so that the rows keep disappearing at the bottom.

202272.overview:
You are Zeke, zoo keeper extraordinaire in charge of the local zoo. Unfortunately, your girlfriend Zelda has been kidnapped by the malicious monkey Marcel! To distract Zeke, Marcel has unlocked the cages in the zoo and the animals are running amok!

It’s up to Zeke to run and jump his way around the perimeter of the zoo to rebuild the walls and recapture the animals before finally climbing the platforms while avoiding coconuts to save Zelda.

460517.overview:
It's a nightmare, but it's true! Research shows that we are the actual aliens on Earth, and the ruthless Zevions are the original inhabitants.

Now the Zevions want Earth back -- minus humans! Their invasion forces are fierce -- the land is crawling with deadly Domogram Rovers; the sky is black with Toroid Patrol Fleets and Zoshi Death Squads.

Our puny weapons offer no defense. Earth's only hope is our powerful new Solvalou Fighter Plane. Its pilot will have a single mission: Penetrate the enemy ranks and destroy the Zeviouz Mother Ship.

The mission is dangerous. We can't guarantee success. But at this point, it's do or die!

One small problem. We still need a pilot. Any volunteers?

This is a work in progress. It uses the 7800 version source code with a remarkable display kernel for the 2600.

465451.overview:
This is a block puzzle game that will challenge you on your Atari 2600!

Inspired by one of the greatest games of all times, Zoltrix will guarantee a lot of fun for you and your family.

Face different levels and challenges. Be smart and find the best strategy to get the highest score.

471360.overview: Detour in trade routes! Gigantic cargo ships are heading towards the alien station Cetus, anchored in Jupiter's orbit. Aboard the spaceship NIX 2-6, you have been informed that the dreaded freighters are transporting cosmic material from the deep mines of the last planet in the system. Your mission is to intercept the immense spaceships and recover the contents of the excavations. To do this, you will have to traverse the 4 planetary orbits, where enemy escort ships and cosmic elements will be waiting for you. Turn on the ship's computer, adjust the coordinates, and prepare to face this battle!

471361.overview: Suspicions confirmed! Alien excavations at the core of the last planet in the system have been discovered and are in full swing. A defense base located on the surface was activated to contain the advances of the mysterious plan, deploying the Venus V.N-8 fleet to reach, as quickly as possible, the stellar refinery installed at the end of the planet and collect as many stars that were discovered during the mining. Now Lord Computer knows of the intentions to thwart his sinister objective and has ordered the excavation machines to engage the Venus fleet directly. Will the robotic mind be able to defeat the defense base and continue with its evil plan? Only you can bring the answer!

471362.overview: The Mysterious Planet! You have been sent into an inhospitable sector of the planetary system, following coordinates from intercepted transmissions from the command base. The messages point to a planet protected by a belt of energy barriers that prevent them from reaching the source of the transmissions. To help with the mission, your ship, the Nebula (N.B-7), was equipped with a perforating laser and supporting scout probes. The probes have the ability to collect information on the molecular structure of the barriers. When in contact with the walls, the probes bring data on the fragility of the force field so that you can, with the perforating laser, open a passage and cross along with them to another layer of protection. You will have to cross the 5 energy barriers that form the protective belt of the planet. What the command base did not foresee is that the alien structures were surrounded by cosmic matter transport machines, which could be a serious risk for the mission. What lies beyond the belt of barriers to be discovered? Lord Computer is watching your movements from somewhere in the universe.

471363.overview: Traveling in the darkness of space aboard the Andromeda A.N-2 spaceship, the command panel's radar tracked an alien station, heading for Neptune, carrying a powerful arsenal of energy. Controlled by a robot brain, the Cetus Station navigates in search of stellar fragments for an as-yet-unknown objective. Now you must invade the immense fortress, traverse its entire length and face the sinister force until the structure's ingrained generators collapse, capturing the Zarkstar and averting impending disaster. However, by touching the obscure fragment, you are automatically transported to another station hidden in the immensity of space. How many bases spread across cosmic infinity will you need to defeat? What will be the plan of this robotic alien mind? This is no time for questions. It's time for a lot of action!

471367.overview: The Star Patrol! New rules imposed by the V Galaxy Command, based on Venus (now a planet inhabited by a civilization that governs galactic justice), authorized the installation of prisons on Earth's Moon, a planet abandoned for more than a century and which is on a path to collision with the Sun. Mars, holder of the most stable mining colonies in the solar system, has made available a new Space Station with enough cargo to supply and repair the latest space fleets. The Red Planet has been a target for looters over the years, but now an unknown race is determined to deactivate the Space Station and take the mined cosmic material to a mysterious planet located in the ancient orbit of Saturn. Under the banner of Star Patrol, you were called upon by the Earth base to maintain order in the 4 quadrants that are now under your jurisdiction. Piloting the Stellar S.T-8 patrol, your role is to maintain controlled space navigation, carrying out 6 missions and crossing space through meteor showers to the action zones. Lord Computer knows where to find you and you feel like you can't put the missions at risk. This is an advanced space exploration adventure. Jump into infinity!

471440.overview:
Catch! Pixel and Atari are bored and want some new cat toys to play with!

Tanya, Darcy and Aerlan decide to head over to the local Pong arena to collect some bouncy balls for the cats to have fun with. There’s only one problem, James needs to start the ZPH show soon!

Help James gather his friends and convince them to come back to the ZeroPage studios, otherwise the show will start late!

This game is for two players and you get to choose which character will face James.

Good luck… for the cats!

474400.overview:
Get ready to attack the Zaxxon fortress!  Navigate your ship over the walls that protect the stronghold while diving to the surface to destroy ground targets and collect fuel to extend your attack.

Prepare to engage in a dogfight with the enemy fleet or traverse through the narrow tunnels while avoiding deadly mines.  If you're good enough to reach the base, you will do battle with the Zaxxon robot itself, or one of the Super Zaxxon mechanical dragons while avoiding heat-seeking rockets and deadly fireballs.

Do you have the skills to complete all 99 levels and claim your spot in the list of elite Zaxxon pilots?

GOOD LUCK!

FEATURES
- 1 or 2 player alternating turns.
- 4 skill levels:  NOVICE, STANDARD, ADVANCED and CHALLENGE mode with additional levels, enemies and power-ups.
- 99 stages to defeat.
- Play with original Zaxxon maps, Super Zaxxon maps, and all new Champ Games  maps!

479094.overview:
You'll need a genesis controller to open the pause menu and equip items.
Levels 1-5 are playable. Levels 1-3 should be fully complete, while . Level 4 has an alternate boss. Level 5 is missing a final boss and could potentially may be unstable as I just implemented a new enemy type introduced in that dungeon.
The north-west portion of the map is blocked off. You might be able to enter some other dungeons, but you won't be able to get very far.
While using certain items, you are able to press fire to attack with a sword (if you have one). For example, using the blue candle after the first time in a room will allow you to stab with your sword
The boomerang is still unimplemented.
You can find secret areas in the overworld using bombs to blow up walls, and the blue candle to burn square bushes. The flute can only be used to uncover one very specific secret.
